title: 第11章 胎铁大弓第12章 麻烦上门
slug: 玄幻苟在深山打猎开局弟妹上门求肉
lines: “等着。”
掌柜的瞥了，王大山一眼，也没多废话。
转身进了堂屋，很快，传来一阵翻箱倒柜的声音。
片刻后，他才重新走了出来，手里提着一张通体漆黑的大弓。
“咣当！”
掌柜随手将弓往柜台上一砸。
“喏，你要重的。”
“这可是个好东西，胎铁打造的。”
“弓身里面嵌了精铁，外面裹着柘木，弓弦用的是上好的牛筋，还掺了成了气候兽类大筋。”
“结实着呢。”
“这弓放在我这有些年头了。”
“来我看弓的人不少，自认力气大的更是一抓一大把。”
“但这把弓，至今还没人能拉得开。”
“怎么样？够劲儿吧？”
“是不错。”
王大山没有理会掌柜，，目光锁定在黑色大弓上。
弓身粗大，线条流畅。
比墙上挂着的那些样子货，不知道强了多少倍。
“确实是把好弓，给我试试。”
他点了点头之后，眼中闪过一丝见猎心喜的笑意。
伸出手，就要去拿那把弓。
“小兄弟，听我一句劝。”
“看看得了，这弓起步就是四石的力道。”
“你要是硬拉，伤了胳膊那是小事，万一闪了腰，那你以后种地都费劲。”
“别到时候赖在我店里不走。”
掌柜的并没有阻拦，只是身子往后一仰，靠在椅背上，摇了摇头。
嘴角挂着一抹，等着看笑话的幸灾乐祸。
“呵呵。”
王大山只是冷笑了一声，大步上前。
单手抓住了弓身。
他深吸一口气，左手持弓，右手搭在了弓弦上。
低喝一声，他双臂猛的发力。
然而。
content_en:
"Wait."
The shopkeeper glanced at Wang Dashan and didn't say much nonsense.
Turning around and entering the main room, there was soon the sound of rummaging through boxes and cabinets.
After a while, he came out again, holding a large black bow in his hand.
"Bang!"
The shopkeeper casually slammed his bow on the counter.
"Here, you want something heavier."
"This is a good thing, made of tire iron."
"The bow body is embedded with fine iron inside and wrapped with eucalyptus wood on the outside. The bow string is made of fine beef tendon and mixed with weather beast tendon."
"It's still strong."
"I've had this bow for a few years."
"Many people come to see my bows, and those who think they are strong grab a lot of them."
"But no one can draw this bow yet."
"How's it going? Is it good enough?"
…
"It's good."
Wang Dashan ignored the shopkeeper and locked his eyes on the big black bow.
The bow body is thick and the lines are smooth.
I don't know how many times better than the ones hanging on the wall.
"It's indeed a good bow. Let me try it."
After he nodded, a smile of joy flashed in his eyes.
Stretch out your hand to get the bow.
"Little brother, listen to my advice."
"Look, this bow is as powerful as four stones at first."
"If you hurt your arm during a deadlift, it's a trivial matter. If your waist slips, you'll have trouble farming in the future."
"Don't stay in my store until then."
The shopkeeper didn't stop him, he just leaned back, leaned on the back of the chair, and shook his head.
There was a hint of schadenfreude on the corner of his mouth, waiting to see a joke.
"Haha."
Wang Dashan just sneered and strode forward.
He grabbed the bow with one hand.
He took a deep breath, held the bow in his left hand, and placed his right hand on the bow string.
"Get up!"
With a low cry, he exerted force on his arms.
However.
